verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud lists AI-powered capabilities, including Grafana Assistant and Investigations. Its Knowledge Graph automatically generates insights about issues, and incident response lets responders investigate with the telemetry that fired the alert. None of the evidence explicitly says the AI produces incident or alert-context summaries for responders. missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated incident summaries, AI summarization of alert context delivered to responders, details of how Investigations works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries of incidents and alert context for responders

citations.quote: Includes AI-powered capabilities for engineering teams, including Grafana Assistant, Investigations, Agent Observability, and more.
generating insights about issues, and connecting metrics, logs, and traces in a unified workflow—no complex queries required.
During an incident, you can investigate with the same metrics, logs, and traces that fired the alert.
